messages:
Samira (support): FYI customer ACME reported ~30% request failures (5xx) and increased timeouts to our hosted inference endpoint in eu-west-1. They hit us during a mid-size batch job. Opening a thread to track mitigation + action items.
Alex P.: Thanks. Can you paste the endpoint and recent request IDs?
Samira (support): endpoint: /v1/inference/generate (prod-eu). Example req id: r_20260315_87a9cd. Logs show upstream gateway 502 -> 504 cascade around 11:04-11:12 UTC.
Mira: I'm seeing elevated connection queueing on gateway pods + occasional auth proxy 504s. p90 CPU on gw-pool-3 jumped.
Cheng: KV cache lookup latency spiked at the same time (redis i/o latencies ~120ms -> 1.2s). Might be correlated with a noisy large-batch workload.
Lydia: Is this the same ACME job we throttled yesterday? They said they'd re-run with bigger batch size.
Support-Luis: Correct, customer indicated a retry loop on their side after some client timeouts; could amplify traffic.
Nate: Ops-Bot shows autoscaler reacted but scale up lagged due to GPU warmup; we had 6->12 pods but new pods were still initializing.
DevRel-John: Workaround suggestion: enable endpoint fallback to a lower-memory model variant to reduce init time. We pushed a temporary routing override for this customer (model v2-small).
Samira (support): Customer accepted fallback; errors subsided but latency still ~2x baseline. Customer wants RCA + action items.
Alex P.: Immediate actions: 1) Add soft rate limit for batch size per-customer (owner: Cheng), 2) Improve autoscaler warmup metrics to pre-warm on scheduled heavy runs (owner: Nate), 3) Add KV-cache read circuit-breaker with cached default for transient timeouts (owner: Mira).
Cheng: Noted. I'll prototype a per-tenant batch-size cap and gate in the request router. Plan: small feature flag rollout to prod-eu next week.
Mira: I'll add a fallback path that returns cached prefix when redis lookup > 200ms and increment a metric for these events.
Nate: I'll tweak the autoscaler to consider pending pods and GPU init time (reduce aggressive downscale), and add a warmup job hook for customers flagged as high batch.
Lydia: We should update support playbook: detect repeated client retries + large batch size and proactively recommend smaller batches + backoff. I'll draft changes (owner: Lydia).
Alex P.: Postmortem items: timeline, root cause (KV latency + client retry amplification + slow autoscale warmup), mitigation verification, and follow-ups above. Assign on-call review tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Samira (support): I'll coordinate customer comms: summarize what we did, expected timeline for fixes, and ask for their batch schedule to avoid future overlap.
Ops-Bot: deploy-bot: Canary routing override to v2-small applied to 1 tenant in prod-eu at 11:30 UTC. :white_check_mark:
DevRel-John: Quick note: consider adding a low-latency model cache (warm replicas) for heavy customers in eu-west to avoid cold starts. Longer-term RFC.
Support-Luis: Customer appreciates the temporary fallback, wants ETA on permanent fixes. I told them we'll follow up after postmortem.
Samira (support): OK closing thread for now; collecting logs/timelines for the postmortem doc. I'll open the postmortem thread and link this. :thumbsup:
